description: Read-only cross-vendor incident snapshot (newest start first). Guest and Free: ongoing plus monitoring only, max 5. Optional status filters ongoing, monitoring, or resolved; resolved requires Standard or higher (includeResolved, timePeriod, or status=resolved). Signed-in callers get additional tools via tools/list, including get_incident per vendor.

includeResolved.description: Include resolved incidents in the fetch. Requires Standard or higher.

limit.description: Maximum incidents to return. Guest and Free maximum is 5. Standard and above maximum is 50.

status.description: Lifecycle bucket: ongoing (active impact), monitoring (watching or fix-pending), resolved (closed). investigating is an alias for ongoing. resolved requires Standard or higher.

timePeriod.description: History window such as 7d, 30d, 90d, or all when allowed by plan. Requires Standard or higher.

name: get_all_vendor_incidents
title: Get All Vendor Incidents
